description: [EMNLP 2026 Main] Speaking While Listening: a survey and empirical audit of full-duplex spoken dialogue systems — L0–L3 architectural hierarchy, T×I×R interaction ontology, and a five-state decision machine, with a curated list of models, datasets, and benchmarks.
